metadata.scenario: A prospect complains about a service they received, stating it did not match the quality promised. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Dorothy Henderson. I'm calling to discuss an issue I had with my last visit from the physical therapist. I'm sorry to hear that, Dorothy. Can you tell me more about what happened? Well, I was expecting a thorough session based on what we discussed, but it felt rushed and the therapist didn't really follow my care plan. I understand your frustration. That does not meet our standards of care. Which therapist did you see? It was Dr. James Rodriguez. Thank you for that information. I will definitely look into this. Can you elaborate on the specific issues you experienced? Sure. It was supposed to be a mobility training session, but we only spent about 20 minutes on exercises. I was really hoping for more focus on my strength training. That sounds disappointing, especially after your hip replacement. I completely understand why you expected more. Exactly, it’s important for my recovery. I’ll make sure to discuss this with Dr. Rodriguez and our team to address the quality of care you received. Thank you. I just want to make sure my recovery is on track. Absolutely, your recovery is our priority. Is there a specific follow-up appointment you'd like to schedule? Yes, that would be great. I’d like to have a session first thing in the morning if possible. Let me check Dr. Rodriguez’s schedule for you. Okay, thank you. It looks like he’s available tomorrow at 8 AM. Does that work for you? Yes, that works perfectly. Great! I’ll book you in for tomorrow at 8 AM. Thank you, I appreciate it. You're welcome. I'll also ensure feedback is given to Dr. Rodriguez regarding today’s complaint. I hope that helps improve the service for others as well. It certainly will, and thank you for bringing this to our attention. Of course, that’s all I can do! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that should be it. Alright, I’ll see you tomorrow at 8 AM. Have a great day, Dorothy. Thanks, Margaret. You too! Goodbye! Goodbye!
